description: List an agent's conversation sessions, newest first: each one's id, status, title, message count, and when it was last updated. Pass a session id to get_session to read one, or to destroy_session to delete it. Titles come from what users said to the agent and may hold personal data: quote only what the person's question needs. Sessions belong to agents; a website or app has none. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_sessions
title: List an agent's sessions
